reference: GNU diffutils 3.10 diff, compared byte for byte (stdout, status) in UTC and the C locale; header times come from files given a fixed mtime with touch.
coverage: Guest pass 3 G46: -N/--new-file, -ruN patches, -c/-C/--context, -U/--unified=N, -s, -B, -i, -b, -Z, -w, -x/--exclude, -X/--exclude-from, -p, -I and option conflicts.
Edit-script choice and change placement among repeated lines, without and with -d, --horizon-lines and the -c/-u context, compared with GNU diff (clean-room matcher, 0.1.5 pass 5).

Guest pass 4 G63: -e/--ed (reverse order, lone '.' lines, incomplete lines), -t/--expand-tabs and --tabsize in every format, -y --suppress-common-lines, --strip-trailing-cr, --color=never|always|auto and --palette with GNU's default palette, and their option errors.

Guest pass 5 G80: -T/--initial-tab, -D/--ifdef, the --*-line-format and --*-group-format options with GNU's % directives and defaults, -n/--rcs, --from-file/--to-file, --no-dereference, --left-column, and -t -y tabs in the right column.
Pass 8 (G120): option errors in GNU form, naming the command only, with the GNU status.
exclusions: Side-by-side output, -q and stdin are covered by suites/diff.json; the -l/--paginate, --suppress-blank-empty, -E, --ignore-tab-expansion and --ignore-file-name-case options are not implemented.
